description:
Find which Peruvian companies export a product and which foreign companies buy it.

    `product` is a keyword, ideally in Spanish as written in customs declarations (e.g. "arandano" for blueberry,
    "palta" for avocado, "uva" for grape, "cobre" for copper, "harina de pescado" for fishmeal, "cacao", "cafe").
    Returns Peruvian exporters (with RUC and total exports) and foreign consignees (with shipment counts and weight).
    Use it to source suppliers in Peru or to identify buyers and competitors in a product market.
name: peru_trade_search_product
title: Find Peruvian exporters and foreign buyers of a product
